risk_note: RV2 settlement (B2-04re; 08 BR-FUND-16 lock procedure step 0 added 2026-11-24, BR-FUND-04 items 7, 9 and 12; orchestrator D10-2759, D10-2784, D10-2800, D10-2829, D10-2862, D10-2875; planning change record docs/changes/20261124-结算批次平台级互斥锁.md). One platform settle credit gate per (app_id, platform): a transaction-level advisory lock in the two-argument form, spelled only in settlement/batch/credit-gate.ts. The batch executor takes it in shared mode as the first statement of every item transaction (order and beneficiary items, every item of a delivery, every platform) before any order key lock, then reads both switches again; either off rolls the item transaction back having written nothing and stops through the existing SB7 path. The supplement launch takes it in exclusive mode after its first source read and before any order key lock or chunk savepoint, holds it to the end of the (caller's) transaction, and reads the platform credit switch again once it is granted: off rolls back to a recheck savepoint (the claimed job row is undone) and refuses with credit_disabled, leaving no row. The bill-day job takes it in exclusive mode after the bill row FOR UPDATE and the replay check and before the source read; a replay takes no gate; whether the main batch is generated follows the switch read after the gate. Supplement candidates take their order key locks in ascending chunks (savepoint, locks, re-read through the injected source port, rollback to the savepoint, the last chunk included); a locked candidate is classified by the row read under its lock; a row that took no order key lock uses the row read after the gate was granted only while it is still not a first-credit candidate (one extra read when there is no candidate), so an order without an order key lock never becomes a first-credit item. The executor's switch read returns at the first off (the master switch read off is not followed by the second read) and counts both on only when the pair was read within the switch cache period, else it reads again and finally throws without crediting or pausing. No amount is computed or changed anywhere; no migration; no contract change; no existing rule test is modified. One protected line is changed by the lane as its own commit: apps/api/src/modules/settlement/AGENTS.md line 24 (hard rule 3, the lock order now starts with the platform gate; D10-2829; money review round 2 read the old and new text and found it consistent with BR-FUND-16 step 0) — it needs the owner's label on the PR head. Accepted residual recorded in the planning change record: clawback, make-up approval and platform restore transactions take only the order key lock, so between a chunk's release and the supplement's commit they may leave one make-up item that points at a closed obligation (skipped at execution) or miss one newly opened obligation (picked up next round); no money moves. Follow-ups: FU-B2-04RE-SPEC-GAPS (three rule-test coverage gaps of spec-test round 3, carried by implementation unit tests [AC-B2-04re-UNIT#1] [#5] [#6] [#11]; the unbounded teardown wait of [AC-B2-04re#8]), FU-EXECUTOR-SWITCH-MONOTONIC-CLOCK (S2 of money round 3: the pair read is timed with the wall clock), FU-B2-04RD-SPEC-R2-GAPS (two gaps carried over with the 14 B2-04rd tests). Test machine on head 58063f5aebcd (tree 0fe05813e324, main 058999ceb): verify-sharded-summary green with scope fast+test:int+test:browser (verify:fast parts base / spec-1 / spec-2 all exit 0; test:int segments 1-6 and rest all exit 0, 2229 files / 20029 tests = int_files_total; --browser exit 0 incl. build-smoke), not_covered test:smoke and db:check (not run on the test machine; this task has no migration).
